description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for network diagnostic tools, including connectivity testing, IPv4/IPv6 address checking, and traceroute functionalities. It includes scripts for form validation, dynamic content updates, and user interactions through JavaScript, as well as HTML structure and embedded PHP for dynamic content and localization.

methods.name: showTracerouteDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with traceroute results, allowing the user to close it.

methods.name: checkTraceError
methods.description: Evaluates traceroute status results to determine if an error occurred and updates the UI accordingly.
